text:
maya: Quick ask — product team wants an animated email hero + social tile set for the inference economics brief. Need accessible SVG banner, 2 subject-line variants, and one static fallback image. Deadline: 36h.

ross: Specs I can take: email hero 600x200 (SVG anim), fallback PNG 1200x400, social 1200x628 + 1080x1080. Email HTML-safe animation (no JS), prefer animated SVG or APNG.

deena: Messaging: short subject A: "How to lower inference cost without sacrificing quality" / subject B: "Reduce token spend — practical tips". CTA: "Read the brief". UTM: utm_source=email, utm_medium=campaign, utm_campaign=inference-econ-kit.

designbot: Export notes: provide SVG + APNG fallback, ensure motion <3s loop, include reduced-motion-ready static frame, color contrast WCAG AA for text on banner, include alt-text lines. Name assets: EMAIL_HERO_SVG_v1, EMAIL_HERO_PNG_v1, SOCIAL_1200x628_v1.

legal: Quick check: avoid unverified savings claims in subject. If we cite % reductions in the brief, add footnote with test conditions. Also ensure privacy/opt-out line appears in the email template.

maya: Good call. Deena will add footnote text. Ross, can you push SVG + fallback PNG to the shared folder and post the preview link here in ~8h? Also please include a minimal code snippet for in-email fallback markup.

ross: Will do. I'll also include alt-text and reduced-motion flag in the README.

deena: I'll prep the short preheader and two author lines for the email body. Legal, I'll DM the footnote copy for approval before final render.

maya: Thanks everyone — once assets land I'll QA across Gmail/Outlook and check UTMs. :white_check_mark:
